npcdefault.htm.text: I have nothing to say to you

Q00045_ToTalkingIsland/30094-01.html.text: Magic Trader Gentler: You came from the boutique shop. Mr.Galladucci's order is ready. It was very hard for me to find. Do you have the order document?

Q00045_ToTalkingIsland/30090-01.html.text: Jeweler Sandra: You're from the country aren't you? Gludio Territory was once beautiful, but it's dangerous to travel nowadays. I have the earrings, you want to see? Beautiful and practical.

Q00045_ToTalkingIsland/30116-01.html.text: Priest Dustin: This place is sacred, where people of faith come to worship. Please keep a respectful silence here. Why are you here, my child?

links.text: "I brought this order from Mr. Galladucci."

Q00045_ToTalkingIsland/30094-04.html.text: Magic Trader Gentler: I'm sure I gave you the item! Take the Magic Sword Hilt to Trader Galladucci at the boutique shop .

Q00045_ToTalkingIsland/30090-04.html.text: Jeweler Sandra: Gemstone Powder is expensive, so please deliver it to Galladucci at the boutique store quickly. Don't get distracted!

Q00045_ToTalkingIsland/30116-04.html.text: Priest Dustin: The necklace is completely purified and safe. Please deliver it to Mr. Galladucci at the boutique shop . I pray that tranquility and happiness will follow you always.

Q00212_TrialOfDuty/30116-01.html.text: Priest Dustin: Welcome, noble Knight. May the blessings of Einhasad be with you. I am troubled by recent violence of the foreign races. We have lost many of our young in fights with them... Just six months ago, a fine, strapping young lad named Leon Athebaldt was killed in battle with the Breka Orc…

Q00212_TrialOfDuty/30116-06.html.text: Priest Dustin: Please gather Sir Leon Athebaldt's remains. You must recover 3 portions: the skull, ribs, and shinbone . It sickens me to think of precious Leon's body decorating the necks of Orcs! This must not stand!

Q00212_TrialOfDuty/30116-07.html.text: Priest Dustin: Thank you so very much. Now we may finally hold a proper funeral for Leon Athebaldt. I have cremated part of his remains and put them into this urn. Please deliver it to Leon's uncle, Sir Collin Windawood . He is the Governor of Talking Island .

Q00212_TrialOfDuty/30116-09.html.text: Priest Dustin: Have you delivered Sir Leon Athebaldt's remains to his family? Sir Collin Windawood of Talking Island is expecting you.

Q00212_TrialOfDuty/30116-08.html.text: Priest Dustin: Well done! I thank you in the name of the church of Einhasad. Sir Athebaldt will at last be at peace in the arms of Einhasad. The peace that we now enjoy would not have been possible without sacrifices such as this. Great things are achieved only at great cost... Sometimes a painful …

Q00212_TrialOfDuty/30116-10.html.text: Priest Dustin: You have done all that I asked. Do you still have the letter of commendation I gave you? Deliver it to Grand Master Hannavalt in Giran .

Q00045_ToTalkingIsland/30116-02.html.text: Priest Dustin: Ah, you're from the boutique shop! Excellent timing, I just finished Mr. Galladucci's order! That curse was very powerful, and I had to ask several priests to help me remove it! I can't believe he was able to hold onto that thing the way it was! Well, now it's been completely purifie…

Q00045_ToTalkingIsland/30116-03.html.text: Priest Dustin: I can't give you the necklace of purity until you give me an order written by Mr. Galladucci himself!

Q00212_TrialOfDuty/30116-02.html.text: Priest Dustin: He was a dashing young knight, sworn to serve Einhasad's holy will and protect the innocent. He took his vow in this very temple. He was an honorable and devout young man, nephew of the famous Sir Collin. He was even considered for canonization by the High Priest! We all had high hop…

Q00212_TrialOfDuty/30116-03.html.text: Priest Dustin: Last winter a giant horde of blood-thirsty Breka Orcs swept in from the north and invaded Giran. Those violent thugs looted homes and businesses, and even threatened the castle. They gave the Royal Guards quite a challenge. Leon Athebaldt led his men in an attack on the Breka Orc enc…

Q00212_TrialOfDuty/30116-04.html.text: Priest Dustin: The Orcs have an appalling custom of carrying around the remains of their enemies as a sort of charm or amulet. They say that the more courageous the enemy, the greater the power... It is said that Athebaldt's remains were cut up into pieces and fashioned into amulets for the Breka O…

Q00212_TrialOfDuty/30116-05.html.text: Priest Dustin: Our religious traditions dictate that we can hold a funeral if we have the skull, ribs, and shinbone. Slay the Breka Orc Overlords and bring back Sir Athebaldt's Skull, ribs, and shinbone .

ai/npc/Trainers/HealerTrainer/30116-note.text: Priest Dustin: Welcome, young friend, to the Temple of Light. Have you come here to learn? I am sorry, but there is no one here who can teach you. My fellow priests and I only receive Human Mystics who seek introduction into the ways of Einhasad.

ai/npc/Trainers/HealerTrainer/30116.html.text: Priest Dustin: Welcome to the Temple of Einhasad, my young friend. Here, priests pass on the divine knowledge granted to us by the goddess of light. Of course, that power must only be used for healing and protection, despite the example of those who would use it for war. Swear to abide by the teach…

Q00045_ToTalkingIsland/30090-02.html.text: Jeweler Sandra: I have prepared everything for you. It's mostly the magicians of the Ivory Tower at Oren Castle that are ordering the Gemstone Powder , so it's quite expensive. Watch out for pickpockets in the crowds! Deliver it to Trader Galladucci quickly.

ai/npc/Trainers/HealerTrainer/learn-lowl.text: In order to use the Skill Transfer system, you must be level 76 or higher and have completed your 3rd class transfer.

ai/npc/Trainers/HealerTrainer/cleanse-no.text: Do you really want to reset your transfer skills? You must use all your Holy Pomanders in order to use this service. After all, 10 million adena is a huge sum of money. Use the rest of your pomanders, then try your request again. Do not fret. I will make sure that all of the Holy Pomanders you used…
To reset the skill link requires 10 million Adena. In addition, your class must corresponding to the skill.

common/skill_enchant_help_01.htm.text: Skill Enchanting allows you to strengthen certain skills that have reached their maximum level. You must be level 76 or above and have completed your 3rd class transfer in order to take advantage of this system. To enchant your skills, simply speak to Agathion Pona. To do this, open your skills win…

common/skill_enchant_help_02.htm.text: Back in the day, Skill Enchanting was a tedious process that could only be done through specific people throughout the land. But those days are gone. Now all you have to do is open your skill window and click on the Skill Enchanting button at the bottom. How easy is that!

common/skill_enchant_help_03.htm.text: There are several Skill Enchanting options at your disposal: General Skill Enchant, Blessed Skill Enchant, Skill Un-Enchanting and Skill Route Change.
